problem:
Which of the following regions are simply connected?

1. ${(x, y) ∈ R^{2} \mid 4x^{2} + y^{2} \le 4}$
2. ${(x, y) ∈ R^{2} \mid y - x \ne 0}$
3. $R^{2}$
worked_solution: Region I is a filled ellipse, so it is convex and therefore simply connected. Region II is the plane with the entire line $y=x$ removed; it splits into the two disjoint half-planes $y>x$ and $y<x$, so it is not connected and hence not simply connected. Region III is the full plane, which is convex and simply connected. Thus I and III only are simply connected.
